name: Hananiah (Shadrach)
title: Daniel's Friend in Babylon
summary: Hananiah was one of Daniel's three friends who were taken captive to Babylon and given the Babylonian name Shadrach. Together with Mishael and Azariah, he refused to worship the king's golden image and was saved unharmed from the fiery furnace.

keyEvents.title: Saved from the Fiery Furnace
keyEvents.description: Hananiah (Shadrach) and his two friends were thrown into the fiery furnace because they refused to worship the golden image, but God saved them unharmed.
